A bag contains 6 red balls, 4 yellow balls and 2 green balls. Three balls are picked at random. What is the probability that at most two are yellow?
solutionText: At most two yellow means 0, 1 or 2 yellow balls. Easy method: 3 yellow na hone ki probability nikalni hai. So first calculate the probability of getting all 3 yellow balls and subtract it from 1. Total balls = 12. P(3 yellow) = C(4,3) / C(12,3) = 4/220 = 1/55. Therefore, P(at most 2 yellow) = 1 - 1/55 = 54/55. Video explanation: https://youtu.be/712h3FYDZVs?si=fFChkyoAPjU-Pp8P&t=152
